units: Deut. XV, 3) cancelling, esp. ה׳ כספים cancelling of (cash) debts in the Sabbatical year.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 10:2:3">Y. Shebi. X, 39ᶜ</cite> bot.; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Gittin 4:3:4">Y. Gitt. IV, 45ᶜ</cite> bot., sq. Y. Macc. I, 31ᵃ bot. <he>כה׳ כספים הוא</he> it is, like a cash debt, forfeited by limitation.
